title: 💠 **Wall Street Journal: 274 US military facilities in 7 countries were damaged during Iran’s attacks**
text:
💠 **Wall Street Journal: 274 US military facilities in 7 countries were damaged during Iran’s attacks**"

"🔹 The Wall Street Journal, publishing new images, has disclosed the widespread scale of destruction to US military bases and infrastructure in regional countries following Iran’s missile and drone attacks."

"🔹 Damage to US military facilities and bases in the Middle East is estimated at up to **$15 billion**."

"🔹 During these attacks, **274 US military facilities in 7 different countries** were targeted and damaged."

"🔹 Iran’s attacks focused on areas where military personnel rest, which led to the killing of **3 US service members in Jordan**."

"🔹 Following these strikes, the US military evacuated part of its forces from bases in Kuwait, and the Pentagon is examining the possibility of moving bases to areas farther from Iran."

"🔹 US officials are deeply concerned that Tehran has preserved its advanced missiles for a new round of conflict.
